title: Piston and cylinder service — review candidate
completeness: Mechanical access, piston/cylinder removal/refit and static closure sequence reviewed; complete dimensional inspection and post-rebuild commissioning remain unresolved. NOT a complete runnable rebuild guide.

source.hash_provenance: Prior frozen Honda source-map capture; current browser bytes NOT independently hashed.
source.document_revision: 61MKEX50_web; introduction states March 2024; official 2026 competition-handbook URL
source.review_note: Current official PDF visually reviewed in Edge. Current HTTP capture returns 403; prior frozen hash is not claimed as a newly verified hash.

applicability.included: Standard US 2026 CRF450R with stock valve train.
excluded: Other years, markets, RX/RWE and modified engines
Head valve/guide/seat work, machining and bottom-end repair

entry_state: Candidate only: exact stock model confirmed, inspection capability and all parts ready before teardown.
exit_state: Static top-end assembly complete only after accepted measurements and four cold clearances.
Engine remains stopped pending separately confirmed commissioning.

required_tools.name: Suitable sockets and torque wrenches covering 5.2, 10, 15 and 22 Nm
Feeler gauges covering both stated clearance ranges
Hose pinch clamp and clean shop towel
Exact handbook diagrams for TDC, breather clamp and tank cushions
Micrometer and qualified dimensional inspection equipment

required_parts: Exact stock replacement piston/rings/pin as inspection requires
Replacement damaged seals and guide as required
consumables: Molybdenum oil solution: engine oil and molybdenum grease 1:1
prerequisites: Verify exact model and cold condition.
Have the cited handbook diagrams available before beginning.

steps.title: Confirm the planned piston work
steps.instruction: This candidate covers stock piston, ring and cylinder removal/refit while retaining a serviceable cylinder head and bottom end. Before teardown, arrange qualified dimensional inspection and exact replacement parts. Head valve/guide/seat repair, machining, crankshaft repair and post-rebuild running clearance are not supplied by this candidate. It is not released for guided use.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Let the engine cool
steps.instruction: Stop the engine and let the cylinder head cool below 35 °C (95 °F). Support the bike securely upright on level ground.
verification: Record cold condition before measuring.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the seat
steps.instruction: Remove the seat mounting bolts and slide the seat forward to release its hooks.
verification: Seat and fasteners retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the radiator shrouds
steps.instruction: Remove each standard R shroud lower and upper bolt and release the shroud from the side-cover tab.
verification: Shrouds removed without breaking tabs.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Prepare the tank support
steps.instruction: Pinch the tank breather hose with a suitable hose clamp and release it from the steering stem. Remove the tank mounting bolt and rear band. Release the clutch hose from its guide.
verification: Breather controlled; tank attachments released.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Support the tank beside the frame
steps.instruction: Protect the frame with a shop towel. Check the tank strap is intact and attached to the frame and tank stay. Lift slowly and hang the tank on the left side using this strap. Keep all load off the connected fuel-feed hose.
verification: Tank secure; fuel hose neither loaded, twisted nor kinked.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the side covers
steps.instruction: Remove each side-cover bolt and slide the cover rearward to release its hook and tab.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the standard muffler
steps.instruction: Loosen the joint band. Remove mounting bolt B and its washer, then mounting bolt A. Support and withdraw the muffler; remove the joint gasket.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the exhaust pipe
steps.instruction: Remove the head joint nuts, exhaust pipe and port gasket. Retain the nuts and protect the open port.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Open rear-frame access
steps.instruction: Remove the air-cleaner lid bolt, release its tabs and remove the lid.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Release the airbox attachments
steps.instruction: Release the ECM suspension tab and lift the ECM from the airbox. Disconnect the black IAT 2P connector and release its wire protector and wire clip. Remove the regulator/rectifier and starter/main-relay mounting bolts and support the assembly clear without pulling its wires.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the rear-frame assembly
steps.instruction: Disconnect the crankcase breather from the airbox and loosen the connecting-tube band at the throttle body. Support the rear frame, remove its upper and lower bolts, release the connecting tube and lift the rear-frame/airbox assembly clear. Leave the fender and airbox assembled for this operation.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Open the plug and cover access
steps.instruction: Blow debris away from the spark-plug base with compressed air. Disconnect the plug cap and remove the plug. Disconnect the crankcase breather hose from the cover.
verification: No debris can enter the plug hole.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the cylinder-head cover
steps.instruction: Remove the cover bolts, mounting rubbers, cover and gasket. Retain the parts cleanly and protect the exposed head from dirt.
verification: Cover removed; sealing parts retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Set compression top dead centre
steps.instruction: Remove the crankshaft-hole cap and O-ring. Turn the crankshaft CLOCKWISE until the primary-drive-gear T mark meets the right-cover index. Cam-sprocket index lines must meet the holder mating surfaces. Match the decompressor-weight position to the compression-TDC drawing on handbook page 2-26. If it is opposite, turn one complete clockwise revolution and align again.
verification: Record correct T mark, cam lines and decompressor position. Do not measure at the opposite stroke.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Measure both intake clearances
steps.instruction: Use a feeler gauge between each intake rocker arm and its cam lobe without damaging the rocker. Record the left and right readings in millimetres. The cold specification is 0.13 ± 0.03 mm.
verification: Both intake readings recorded against 0.10–0.16 mm.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Measure both exhaust clearances
steps.instruction: Measure between each exhaust rocker arm and its shim. Record the left and right readings in millimetres. The cold specification is 0.28 ± 0.03 mm.
verification: Both exhaust readings recorded against 0.25–0.31 mm.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Retract and lock the tensioner
steps.instruction: Remove the tensioner-lifter cap bolt and sealing washer. Use stopper 070MG-0010100 or US 07AMG-001A100; turn it clockwise to its stop, then push the tabs into the grooves to retain the retracted tensioner.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the cam holder
steps.instruction: Remove the holder bolts and lift the holder while retaining the bearing set rings. Keep all small parts away from the crankcase opening.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the camshaft
steps.instruction: Remove the set rings. Slide the left bearing toward the sprocket until it contacts it and remove the right bearing. Release the chain from the sprocket and lift out the cam. Secure the chain with wire so it cannot fall inside.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Record and remove the shims
steps.instruction: Use a magnet or tweezers to remove each shim without damaging intake rockers. Preserve its original position. Wipe off oil, measure actual thickness with a micrometer and record each value with the corresponding cold clearance.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Drain the cold cooling system
steps.instruction: With the bike upright and the engine and radiator cool, remove the coolant drain bolt and sealing washer. Slowly remove the radiator cap; the upper shroud bolt is already removed. Lean the machine each way several times to finish draining.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the rocker arms
steps.instruction: Pull the intake rocker shaft and remove both intake rockers, preserving left/right identity. Temporarily thread a suitable 8 mm bolt into the exhaust rocker shaft to withdraw it. Remove both exhaust rockers, then remove the temporary bolt.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Release the head attachments
steps.instruction: Disconnect the ignition-coil primary connectors and remove the coil and mounting bolts. Loosen the insulator band, release the throttle body and support it without loading its hoses or cables. Remove the head hanger bolts, plate bolts, plates and collar. Disconnect the black ECT 2P connector and release radiator hose A after loosening its band.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the cylinder head
steps.instruction: Remove the head 6 mm bolt. Loosen the four main head bolts in a crisscross pattern over two or three stages. Remove the rear bolts and washers. Lift the head enough to remove the front bolts and washers, then lift it off while retaining the chain. Remove dowels and gasket.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the cylinder
steps.instruction: Remove the chain guide. Lift the cylinder while supporting the piston and retaining the chain. Remove the base gasket and dowels without dropping them into the case.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Remove the piston
steps.instruction: Protect the crankcase opening with a shop towel. Remove the pin clips and press the pin out without damaging it or the piston. Remove the piston. Spread rings only as far as necessary and lift them off opposite each gap. Do not polish the pin.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Inspect and measure the removed parts
steps.instruction: Inspect the cylinder, piston, rings, pin and connecting-rod small end for damage, abnormal wear or deformation. Record actual measurements and acceptance against handbook page 2-37. Piston diameter is measured 5 mm above the skirt bottom. This candidate does not supply the complete metrology technique; obtain qualified inspection before fitting parts. Replace parts outside their applicable service limits; do not continue with an unresolved head, rod or cylinder defect.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the rings
steps.instruction: Clean grooves without damage and oil the entire ring surfaces. Fit the spacer then side rails; fit the top ring with its mark upward. Use the page 2-38 drawing: top-ring and upper-rail gaps are 180 degrees apart and oil-ring gaps are 90 degrees apart. Verify rings rotate freely without sticking.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the piston and new clips
steps.instruction: Protect the case opening. Apply molybdenum oil solution to the rod small-end inner surface and pin outer surface; use engine oil on the piston exterior and pin hole. Molybdenum oil solution is equal parts engine oil and molybdenum grease. Face the IN mark and large valve recesses toward intake. Insert the pin and NEW clips; seat both fully with their gaps away from piston cutouts.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Prepare the cylinder base
steps.instruction: Clean the mating surface. Apply TB1141G by ThreeBond or equivalent to the case-side split-line patches shown on page 2-39, following the illustrated 5–10 mm extent on each side. Fit dowels and a NEW base gasket. Do not apply an invented bead size elsewhere.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the cylinder
steps.instruction: Oil the bore, piston exterior and rings. Route the chain and tensioner through the cylinder and compress the rings by hand while lowering the cylinder over the supported piston. Avoid damaging the rings.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the chain guide
steps.instruction: Inspect the guide slipper and replace it if worn or damaged. Engage its tabs with the cylinder grooves and its lower end with the crankcase groove.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the retained head
steps.instruction: Fit dowels and a NEW head gasket. Apply engine oil to the front main-head-bolt threads and seating surfaces. Put those bolts and washers into the head before lowering the head onto the cylinder, retaining the chain.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Tighten the head
steps.instruction: Oil the rear main-head-bolt threads and seating surfaces and install them with washers. Tighten all four main bolts to 50 Nm in crisscross order over two or three stages. Install the separate 6 mm head bolt securely.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Restore the head connections
steps.instruction: Refit radiator hose A with the band-end gap at 0–0.5 mm as shown. Reconnect the black ECT 2P connector. Install hanger plates and collar; tighten hanger bolts FIRST to 54 Nm, then plate bolts to 32 Nm.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Refit the throttle body and coil
steps.instruction: Engage the throttle-body lug in the insulator groove and the band hole over its locating boss. Tighten the band screw until both ends fully seat on the collar. Install the ignition coil and secure its bolts; restore both primary connectors.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the rocker arms
steps.instruction: Apply molybdenum oil solution to exhaust-rocker inner and shim slipper surfaces; install left/right with identifying marks outward. Use the temporary 8 mm bolt to position the exhaust shaft with its cutout as drawn, then remove the bolt. Lubricate intake-rocker inner, cam slipper and shim slipper surfaces; install left/right with marks facing right, never upside down. Position its shaft cutout as drawn.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Select and install the shims
steps.instruction: Use the recorded cold readings and actual shim thicknesses: new thickness = measured clearance − specified clearance + old thickness. Intake target is 0.13 mm; exhaust target is 0.28 mm. Available shims run 1.200–3.000 mm in 0.025 mm increments. Measure each chosen shim with a micrometer and install it in its recorded position. A calculation beyond the available range or suspected valve-seat/carbon problem requires excluded repair before proceeding.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Check the decompressor and timing
steps.instruction: Confirm the primary T mark is still aligned. Check the decompressor weight and spring: after finger movement, it must return automatically. An abnormal mechanism requires repair outside this candidate. Apply molybdenum oil solution to cam lobes. Install the cam with intake lobes up, decompressor weight and sprocket lines as shown on page 2-30, and engage the chain.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Seat the cam bearings and holder
steps.instruction: Seat the left bearing against the cam rib; install the right bearing. Fit both set rings into their bearing grooves. Align holder grooves to the rings and dowels to head holes; align rocker-shaft cutouts with holder bolt holes.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Tighten the holder
steps.instruction: Oil holder-bolt threads and seating surfaces. The exhaust-side bolts are long and intake-side bolts short. Tighten them to 15 Nm.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Release and oil the tensioner
steps.instruction: Remove the stopper. Through the bolt hole apply MORE THAN 2.0 cm³ of engine oil onto the slit surface of the tensioner shaft. Install a NEW sealing washer and secure the cap bolt.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Rotate and remeasure
steps.instruction: Turn the crankshaft clockwise several revolutions to settle the shims. Return to compression TDC using the T mark, sprocket lines and decompressor orientation. Remeasure all four cold clearances at the same measurement locations. Record results. If any reading is outside its range, repeat the reviewed tensioner/cam/shim selection and refit sequence before closure; never run an engine with an unresolved result.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Close the crankshaft access
steps.instruction: Fit a NEW O-ring lubricated with engine oil. Grease the crankshaft-hole cap threads and tighten the cap to 15 Nm.
verification: New O-ring seated; cap tightened.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Inspect and fit the cover seals
steps.instruction: Inspect the plug-hole seal ring and cover gasket for damage or deterioration and replace affected parts. Apply engine oil to the plug-hole seal ring. Fit the gasket into the cover.
verification: Seals serviceable and located correctly.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the cover
steps.instruction: Seat the cover without displacing the gasket or plug-hole seal. Replace damaged or scored mounting rubbers; fit them with UP marks upward. Tighten the cover bolts to 10 Nm.
verification: Cover and rubbers seated; bolts tightened.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Reconnect the head breather
steps.instruction: Reconnect the breather with its white mark facing upward. Orient the clamp to the 45-degree position in the handbook page 2-28 diagram.
verification: Hose secure with the cited orientation.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the spark plug
steps.instruction: Start the plug by hand to avoid crossing its threads, then tighten to 22 Nm. Reconnect the plug cap securely.
verification: Plug correctly threaded and cap seated.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Refit the rear-frame assembly
steps.instruction: Seat the connecting tube on the throttle body and loosely mount the rear frame. Tighten upper bolts FIRST to 32 Nm, then lower bolts to 44 Nm. Align the tube-band hole with its lug; set the screw dimension shown on page 1-9 to 6–9 mm. Restore the breather with clip orientation as drawn, regulator/relay mounting, wire clip/protector, black IAT 2P, ECM suspension and airbox lid.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Refit the standard exhaust
steps.instruction: Fit a NEW port gasket and loosely mount the pipe. Fit the muffler band tab into its cutout and a NEW muffler joint gasket; loosely mount the muffler with A, washer and B. Tighten pipe nuts to 20 Nm, then secure muffler mounting A before B, then tighten its joint band to 20 Nm.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Refill and bleed coolant
steps.instruction: Install a NEW drain sealing washer and secure the drain bolt. Upright on level ground, fill to the neck with Pro Honda HP coolant or equivalent corrosion-inhibited ethylene glycol at the standard 1:1 distilled-water concentration. Listed capacities are 1.08 L at change and 1.14 L after disassembly. Lean about 20 degrees each way several times; top up and repeat if the level falls. Secure the cap.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Return the tank
steps.instruction: Check the frame cushion rubbers are present and in the handbook page 2-11 locations, including the illustrated 181 ± 2.5 mm positioning. Lower the tank without twisting or bending the fuel-feed hose. Restore the rear band and mounting bolt securely, route the clutch hose in its guide, return the breather to the steering stem and remove its temporary pinch clamp.
verification: Tank supported on its cushions; straps, hose guide and breather restored.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Refit the side covers
steps.instruction: Engage each cover hook in the rear-fender groove and align its tab with the shroud slot during shroud installation. Tighten side-cover bolts to 10 Nm.
verification: Action complete with parts correctly located.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the shrouds
steps.instruction: Engage each shroud slot with the side-cover tab. Tighten lower bolts to 10 Nm and upper bolts to 5.2 Nm.
verification: Both shrouds secure with tabs engaged.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Install the seat
steps.instruction: Engage the seat hooks with the fuel-tank slot, rear frame and rear-fender grooves. Tighten the mounting bolts to 10 Nm.
verification: Seat hooks engaged and seat secure.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; recording and failed-result handling are application workflow.

steps.title: Record the static assembly result
steps.instruction: Record accepted dimensions, shim sizes, four final clearances and completed assembly. Keep the engine stopped until post-rebuild running, leak inspection and break-in instructions have been separately confirmed. This candidate does not authorize an unreviewed first start.
verification: Record the observed result and resolve any failed condition before continuing.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; dependency gates are application workflow.

stop_conditions: Any cold reading outside its cited range
TDC or decompressor orientation cannot be confirmed
Tank support strap or fuel hose damaged
release_hold: Out-of-range clearance repeat needs explicit runtime loop/branch before release
